reason: In packages/features/ee/workflows/api/scheduleSMSReminders.ts, if `twilio.scheduleSMS` succeeds (line 159) but the following `prisma.workflowReminder.update` storing `scheduled`/`referenceId` throws (line 169), the catch only increments `retryCount` (line 190); after two such runs the new `retryCount > 1` clause in `deleteMany` (lines 38-42) deletes the row while the Twilio jobs stay scheduled with no stored sid. The uncancellable Twilio job after a failed update existed before the patch; the patch adds the row deletion.
